purpose: Editable settings for the research pipeline. Vocabulary and document routing only; nothing here is evidence or a legal rule.
glossary: ADL = activities of daily living; CBLTSS = community based long term services and supports; CDPAP/CDPAS = consumer directed personal assistance program/services; CHA = community health assessment; DME = durable medical equipment; FAD/IAD = final/initial adverse determination; FFS = fee-for-service; HARP = health and recovery plan; LDSS = local department of social services (social services district); MAP = Medicaid Advantage Plus; MLTC/MLTCP = managed long term care (plan); MMC = mainstream Medicaid managed care; MRG = Medicaid Reference Guide; NH/SNF = nursing home / skilled nursing facility / residential health care facility / nursing facility; NYIAP = New York Independent Assessor Program (the independent assessor); OON = out of network; PACE = Program of All-inclusive Care for the Elderly; PCS = personal care services; PDN = private duty nursing; TPHI/TPL = third party health insurance / third party liability (other health coverage an enrollee has, which can include Medicare); UAS-NY = Uniform Assessment System for New York (the assessment tool; a 'UAS-NY assessment' is the community health assessment / nursing assessment of the individual); dual eligible = has both Medicare and Medicaid.

core_documents._comment: Title substrings of documents that are always searched for a plan category, in addition to whatever the planner picks. A researcher always checks the governing contract, the federal managed care rules and the State plan statute.
*: 42 C.F.R. Ch. IV, Sub. C, Pt. 438
